name: The Constant Driver
goal: Tap BRAKE when the brake lights come on. Do not brake for indicators or boards.
tip: Keep your eyes on the vehicle's lights. Red on both sides means brake; one blinking orange light means wait.
voice: You are driving behind another vehicle.
When its two red brake lights come on, tap BRAKE quickly.
If only one orange light blinks, or a board passes by, do not brake.
Later, a yellow speed-breaker sign also means brake.
too_early: Nothing to brake for yet. Wait for the lights.
no_brake_indicator: That was an indicator. No need to brake.
no_brake_board: That was a board. No need to brake.
